title: Been working on this game for just over 10 weeks and finally got it on the Play Store!
author: BeltwayBro
selftext:
Hey gang!

I've been lurking and learning here for a while, and today I'm finally posting something I actually finished.

Some background: I'm a long time gamer but an absolute noob in terms of game dev. I didn't even know what a sprite sheet was in 2025, lol. I've cut my teeth on a lot of game concepts over the last 12 months. Mostly quick and dirty builds that my kiddos could play but a few real attempts at a commercial level game. Wraith Lord is the first one I've actually seen all the way through and published.

The game: a dark fantasy auto-battler for Android. You only move; your spectral Wraith Limbs do the fighting, and every victory makes you permanently stronger. No runs, no resets, no level cap.

Since this is [r/aigamedev](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/), here's roughly how AI fit into the workflow:

• Coding: Claude Code for most of the game logic, systems, and the Android/Capacitor build (it started as a Lovable prototype)

• Base Art: ChatGPT for concepts, key art, and static assets (logo, weapons, icons, emblems), plus the base images I fed into Autosprite and Grok

• Sprites: Autosprite Paid plan (totally worth it IMO) via its MCP server, so Claude Code could generate the 8-direction walk/attack/death sheets and wire them straight into the game

• Key art animation: Grok Imagine (load screen, cut scene)

• Voiceover: FineVoice

• The trailer itself: assembled in code with Remotion. Gameplay is real screen recordings from my phone, the Wraith Limbs are a port of the game's own rendering code, and every other asset is pulled straight from the game files

I want to say thank you to this community. The feedback on earlier posts and all the resources people share here (workflows, tool breakdowns, honest post-mortems) genuinely helped me get over the finish line this time.

A personal favor, if you're up for it: please download it, play for a bit, and tell me what you think, good or bad. As a solo dev, every install and every bit of feedback helps a ton.

Google Play: [Wraith Lord: Endless Vigil](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.pivothouse.wraithlord)

And as a thank-you, two codes for a head start (just tap avatar on top left to seem code input)

• WL5K: +5,000 HP

• WLRARE: one Rare weapon of each class

Happy to answer anything about the build, the tools, or what I'd do differently. Thanks for reading
